functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nothingsports_recovery.alias_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin new.event_id := nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(new.event_id); if tg_table_name='nothingsports_nsc_points' and tg_op='INSERT' then if exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_nsc_points p where p.user_id=new.user_id and nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(p.event_id)=new.event_id and p.action_key=new.action_key) then return null; end if; end if; -- bledisloe-pending-timing-v1
 if tg_table_name='nothingsports_reminders' and new.event_id='rugby-australia-new-zealand-2026-10-17' then
 if new.dispatched_at is null and new.delivery_started_at is null and new.delivery_mode='match-15' then
 new.starts_at:='2026-10-17T05:00:00Z'::timestamptz;new.remind_at:='2026-10-17T04:45:00Z'::timestamptz;new.schedule_starts_at:=new.starts_at;
 end if;end if;
 return new; end $function$
